title: Critical role of coexistence order and interfacial forces in the aggregation of polystyrene nanoplastics induced by nano-SiO2 and metal cations
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00392J, Paper
Pengju Ren, Yihan Chi, Lijuan Wang, Yuanyuan Tang
This study investigated the aggregation of polystyrene (PS) nanoplastics (NPs) by kinetic experiments, considering single, simultaneous, and sequential addition of silica (SiO2) nanoparticles and metal cations.
